title: News feed
prompt: Design the home feed of a social network: users post updates, follow other users, and see recent posts from the people they follow.
hard_part: Fan-out on write vs read; celebrities
key_points: Compared fan-out on write with fan-out on read, with the cost of each
Proposed the hybrid: push for ordinary accounts, merge celebrity posts at read time
Used cursor pagination and time-ordered IDs, not offsets
Covered hydration: batch-fetching post bodies, authors and counts from caches
Gave authors read-your-writes on their own posts, and handled deletes and unfollows by filtering at read time
Treated feed lists as a rebuildable cache, with a tested fallback when they're lost
